definition_en: The ability to write, debug, and maintain code in programming languages to build software, automate tasks, or solve computational problems.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk menulis, menyahpepijat dan menyelenggara kod dalam bahasa pengaturcaraan bagi membina perisian, mengautomasikan tugasan atau menyelesaikan masalah pengiraan.
typical_tasks_en:
• Write a Python script to automate monthly invoice generation.
• Debug why the online form validation is failing for mobile users.
• Build a small internal tool to track employee training hours.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Tulis skrip Python untuk mengautomasikan penjanaan invois bulanan.
• Nyahpepijat mengapa pengesahan borang dalam talian gagal untuk pengguna mudah alih.
• Bina alat dalaman kecil untuk menjejak jam latihan pekerja.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires writing or modifying code in any programming language
• The task involves debugging or testing software
• The task requires automating tasks through scripts or programs
• The task involves developing algorithms or data structures
• The task requires maintaining or refactoring existing codebases
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only using software without writing code
• The user configures tools through graphical interfaces only
• The task requires no understanding of programming logic
• The user is copying code without comprehension of how it works
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task uses software, no-code tools, or copies code without understanding.

confusions.boundary_rule: Programming is general coding. AI is a specialised application.
confusions.example_task: Write code to train a recommendation model.

confusions.boundary_rule: Programming creates software. Technological literacy uses existing tools.
confusions.example_task: Build a custom plugin for the CRM.

confusions.boundary_rule: Programming implements designs. Design defines user experience.
confusions.example_task: Code the interactive prototype designed by the UX team.
